description_en: Grants a user group permissions on hosts and host accounts
description_zh: 为用户组授权主机及主机账户
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost attach-host-accounts-to-user-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-group-id 1 --hosts HostId_:_1_,_HostId_:_2_,_HostAccountIds_:_1_,_2_,_3_,..._,_HostId_:_3_,_HostAccountIds_:_4_,_5_,_6_,..._,_HostId_:_4_,_HostAccountIds_:_9_,_8_,_7_,..._... --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachHostAccountsToUserGroup

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the bastion host where the user group to be granted authorization resides.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要授权主机和主机账户的用户组所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host instance where the user group to be authorized resides.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要授权主机和主机账户的用户组所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user group to be authorized with hosts and host accounts.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204509.html operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要授权主机和主机账户的用户组ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204509.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: user_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The host IDs and host account IDs to be authorized for the user group. You can specify up to 10 host IDs, and each host supports up to 10 host account IDs. You do not need to specify host account IDs. If you do not specify host account IDs, only the hosts are authorized for the user group. For the specific structure of this parameter, see the Hosts parameter structure description below the request parameters list.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html operation to query host IDs and call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204372.html operation to query host account IDs
parameters.help_zh:
指定要为用户组授权的主机ID和主机账户ID。最多支持设置10个主机ID，每个主机最多支持设置10个主机账户ID。您可以不设置主机账户ID，不设置主机账户ID表示仅为用户组授权主机。该参数的具体结构请参考请求参数列表下的Hosts参数结构说明。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html接口获取主机ID，调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204372.html接口获取主机账户ID
parameters.name: hosts
